subject: Whoa J&As — Oct 20: ICE letter-contracts Amentum for Camp East Montana after terminating prior contract, $1.2B
body:
## 1. ICE letter-contracts Amentum for Camp East Montana after terminating prior contract, $1.2B

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Amentum Services Inc. · $1,229,179,038.02 · RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award 70CDCR26C00000016, “Camp East Montana”*

ICE proposes a sole-source letter contract with Amentum Services Inc. for detention services at Camp East Montana, funded by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. The justification cites performance deficiencies under the Army-issued contract, which ICE terminated.

> “Because this is a letter contract, the estimated total value is based upon the independent government cost estimate (IGCE) until the contract is fully negotiated at definitization.”  
> — Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted for Public Release.pdf, p. 1 (machine-transcribed page)

> “ICE was not the source selection authority for the original task order, resulting in a contract and Performance Work Statement (PWS) that did not accurately reflect ICE's operational needs”  
> — Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted for Public Release.pdf, p. 3 (machine-transcribed page)

> “Total | | | $1,229,179,038.02 Note: Because this is a letter contract, the estimated total value is based upon the independent government cost estimate (IGCE) until the contract is fully”  
> — Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted for Public Release.pdf, p. 1 (machine-transcribed page) (source of the figure above, quoted by the checks)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/53d80bf144804de8a5e5138dd62cf873/view) · [Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted for Public Release.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/53d80bf144804de8a5e5138dd62cf873/d83bcd08bad544b3aa3b1c22a208bcc9_Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted_for_Public_Release.pdf) · [Other Than Full and Open Competition Redacted for Public Release_10.19.26.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/53d80bf144804de8a5e5138dd62cf873/d542b26604ce40a598782fbee8c9a018_Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted_for_Public_Release_10.19.26.pdf)

## 2. VA extends Community Care Network Region 3 sole-source amid protests and 1,600 questions

**VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF · RFO 6.103-2**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award 36C79119D0006, “Q201--CCN R3 Contract Extension”*

VA seeks up to one year of unusual-and-compelling-urgency performance for CCN Region 3 because the next-generation procurement is delayed. The document cites two protests, more than 1,600 industry questions and possible litigation.

> “The scope and complexity of the procurement, combined with two protests, more than 1,600 industry questions, and potential future litigation risks, continue to push key milestones to the right.”  
> — Attachment 1 - Justification  Approval Redacted R3.pdf, p. 3

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/c4bad86f34314b579a52144c1c0d2fa0/view) · [Attachment 1 - Justification  Approval Redacted R3.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/c4bad86f34314b579a52144c1c0d2fa0/fa1e4af44f4444d587726fbde019bcf6_Attachment_1_-_Justification_Approval_Redacted_R3.pdf) · [36C79119D0006 P00152_2.docx](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/c4bad86f34314b579a52144c1c0d2fa0/2930175d7b6449359032dd679845b053_36C79119D0006_P00152_2.docx)

## 3. DARPA plans $499.8M five-year sole-source IDIQ with Johns Hopkins APL

**DEFENSE ADVANCED RESEARCH PROJECTS AGENCY  (DARPA) (DEPT OF DEFENSE) · Johns Hopkins University, Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL) · $499,800,000 · 10 U.S.C. § 3204(a)(3)**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award HR001127DE001, “JUSTIFICATION FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION”*

DARPA seeks a single-contractor IDIQ with JHU/APL, a UARC, with a stated ceiling and 60-month term.

> “The estimated IDIQ ceiling amount is $499,800,000 (maximum quantity) with a 60-month period of performance. The guaranteed minimum is $10,000.”  
> — JA for Other Than Full and Open Competition_Redacted.pdf, p. 1

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/bbb330117065468cba78b17e6f255e14/view) · [JA for Other Than Full and Open Competition_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/bbb330117065468cba78b17e6f255e14/6d9580a1947a492cadf81d3c89e06bbe_JA_for_Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted.pdf)

## 4. HHS plans sole-source continuity buy of Anthropic's Claude for its workforce

**OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT SECRETARY FOR FINANCIAL RESOURCES (ASFR) (HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF) · Anthropic**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, “Intent to Sole Source to Anthropic”*

HHS intends a stopgap sole-source award for enterprise access to Claude, pending a competitive multiple-award BPA for frontier AI models.

> “This action provides continued enterprise access to Anthropic's Claude frontier models and advanced features (Claude for Enterprise / Claude for Government) for authorized HHS workforce”  
> — SAM.gov notice description

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/3280f97fd5a045459cf5e0e31ea1415d/view)

## 5. GAO protest forces Marine Corps sole-source for Mi-24 Hind adversary aircraft

**DEPT OF THE NAVY (DEPT OF DEFENSE) · VTS Aviation LLC · $527,834.44 · 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(2)**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award M0068126P0076, “WTI 1-27 Sole Source J&A”*

After a protest and corrective action, the Marine Corps awarded a sole-source purchase order for adversary rotary-wing and drone threat replication. The J&A says the stay left a gap that advance planning could not have prevented.

> “The stay occurred 49 days prior to the live-flight phase, creating an unexpected, immediate gap in cont racted threat repli cation that could not have been prevented through advance planning.”  
> — MCIWEST WTI-1-27 JA signed (1).pdf, p. 2

> “The estimated dollar value of the contract is $527,834.44, funded using FY26 Operations and Maintenance, Marine Corps (O&M, MC) appropriations. 4.”  
> — MCIWEST WTI-1-27 JA signed (1).pdf, p. 1 (source of the figure above, quoted by the checks)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/077d851fe0a7404abb51862ff565859f/view) · [MCIWEST WTI-1-27 JA signed (1).pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/077d851fe0a7404abb51862ff565859f/9909d154bbac44c88e43017196bb3d08_MCIWEST_WTI-1-27_JA_signed_1_.pdf)
